test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements related to the Mughal empire in India is/are correct?

**Statement A: **The Second Battle of Panipat marked the beginning of Akbar’s rule and also his territorial expansion.

**Statement B:** The Battle of Haldighati was a historic battle fought during the rule of Akbar, in June 1576.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Second Battle of Panipat:**

 
 
• The **second Battle of Panipat** took place in **1556**, where Mughal Emperor** Akbar's forces **clashed against the forces of **Hemu**, a Hindu King.
 
• This battle marked the **beginning of Akbar's rule as he was only 13 years old** at the time and just beginning to establish his authority.
 
• After the victory in this battle, **Akbar and his guardian Bairam Khan **started a series of campaigns to expand the Mughal Empire across India.
 
• Akbar's rule was marked by his wise and visionary policies, which eventually led to a unified and prosperous Mughal empire covering most of the **Indian subcontinent**.
 
• The second Battle of Panipat holds an important place in Mughal history and India's history due to the** beginning of Akbar's successful rule**. ***Hence Statement A is correct.***
 
 
 
• **Battle of Haldighati:**
 
 
• The** Battle of Haldighati **was fought between the** Mughals and Maharana Pratap of Mewar** in **June 1576**, during the reign of Mughal Emperor **Akbar. *Hence Statement B is also correct.***
 
• **Raja Man Singh I,** a trusted general of the Mughal emperor Akbar,** led the Mughal forces** in the battle.
 
• The battle is remembered for the** bravery of Maharana Pratap **and his **horse Chetak,** who is said to have saved his master's life but succumbed to injuries itself.
 
• The Battle of Haldighati had a significant impact on the region's politics and history, as it highlighted the resistance against the Mughal rule and the **valour of Rajput warrior Maharana Pratap**.
 
• Although the battle **didn't result in a decisive victory for either side**, it was a notable event in the history of the Mughal empire and Akbar's rule [0].
